nodes.label: Frontend Components — U1 Publishable Site Shell
Build-time markup structure, no runtime state
nodes.rationale: NFR2 requires pages served complete with no loading state and C6 disqualifies client-side rendering, so props are render-time inputs and state is only render branches.

nodes.label: Keyboard order follows document order (no tabindex)
Responsive structural commitments for U5 (rail sibling, one-link rows, plain nav list)
No forms and no API integration points
nodes.rationale: Comments, newsletter, admin are excluded entirely; CSP form-action 'none' and default-src 'self' / script-src 'none' enforce the absence.
